propositions: Canonical contributor guidance hardcodes a specific maintainer bot identity (Joe Oakhart) in sign-off examples despite policy requiring contributors to sign with their own real configured identity.
Documentation is inconsistent: AGENTS.md and .agents/rules/rebar.md prescribe the bot identity while CONTRIBUTING.md requires real contributor names for DCO compliance.
Contributor-facing guidance must be updated to instruct users to verify and sign-off with their own configured git user.name and user.email rather than a hardcoded third-party identity.

A deterministic lint check must be added to prevent reintroduction of hardcoded personal sign-offs in contributor-facing documentation, excluding automation-owned paths (infra/, .github/workflows/, tests/, docs/experiments/).
